title: HP TET JBT · July 2022 (previous year questions)
description: Questions asked in the HP TET JBT exam of the June 2022 session (held 24 July 2022), with answers checked against a published solved paper and independently verified. Not the complete paper: garbled or doubtful questions were left out.

questions.text: Which one of the following is the primary agency of socialisation?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी समाजीकरण की एक प्रमुख संस्था है?
questions.explanation: The family is the first and primary agency of socialisation; peers, school and media are secondary agencies. (Q1 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: A child of sixteen years scores 75 in I.Q. test, his mental age will be years.
questions.textHi: 16 वर्ष का एक बच्चा, बुद्धि-लब्धि परीक्षण में 75 (IQ) प्राप्त करता है, उसकी मानसिक आयु होगी।
questions.explanation: IQ = (MA/CA) × 100, so MA = 75 × 16 / 100 = 12 years. (Q2 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Traits of Gifted students are -
questions.textHi: प्रतिभाशाली विद्यार्थियों के गुण होते हैं-
optionsHi: सामान्य बुद्धि का अधिक प्रयोग करते हैं।
विषय-वस्तु को समझने में विश्वास रखते हैं।
मौलिक चिन्तन करने की प्रवृत्ति - होती है।
questions.explanation: The key treats all listed traits (practical sense, understanding over rote learning, abstract thinking) as traits of gifted learners. (Q3 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Piaget's which stage is related to abstract and logical thinking?
questions.textHi: पियाजे की कौन-सी अवस्था का संबंध अमूर्त एवं तार्किक चिंतन से है?
questions.explanation: Piaget's formal operational stage (about 11+ years) is marked by abstract and logical (hypothetical) reasoning. (Q4 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Which of the following evaluation comes in the continuous and comprehensive evaluation?
options: Both Formative Assessment and Summative Assessment
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा मूल्यांकन सतत् एवं व्यापक मूल्यांकन में आता है?
optionsHi: रचनात्मक आकलन तथा योगात्मक आकलन दोनों
questions.explanation: CCE combines formative (ongoing) and summative (end-of-term) assessment. (Q5 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Child-centred education was advocated by which of the following thinkers?
questions.textHi: बाल केन्द्रित शिक्षा का समर्थन निम्नलिखित में से किस विचारक द्वारा किया गया?
questions.explanation: John Dewey, the pragmatist educationist, championed child-centred, activity-based education. (Q6 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Who propounded the Kindergarten method?
questions.textHi: किंडरगार्टन विधि का प्रतिपादन किसने किया?
questions.explanation: Friedrich Froebel founded the Kindergarten ("children's garden") in 1837. (Q7 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: According to Freud, 'Id' is based on the ........ principle.
questions.textHi: फ्रायड के अनुसार 'इदम्' ........ सिद्धान्त पर आधारित है।
questions.explanation: Freud's id seeks immediate gratification and works on the pleasure principle; the ego follows the reality principle. (Q8 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: What is the relationship between Intelligence and Creativity?
questions.textHi: बुद्धि व सृजनात्मकता में किस प्रकार का संबंध पाया जाता है
questions.explanation: Intelligence and creativity are positively but only moderately correlated. (Q9 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Which stage is considered most difficult period of life?
questions.textHi: जीवन का सबसे कठिन काल माना जाता है
questions.explanation: Adolescence is called a period of "stress and storm" (Stanley Hall) and is considered the most difficult stage. (Q10 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: The 'Progressive Matrices' test was developed by
questions.textHi: 'प्रोग्रेसिव मैट्रिसेस' परीक्षण किस मनोवैज्ञानिक ने विकसित किया?
questions.explanation: John C. Raven developed the non-verbal Raven's Progressive Matrices test (1938). (Q11 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Which psychologist has used nonsense words as learning material?
questions.textHi: किस मनोवैज्ञानिक ने अधिगम सामग्री के रूप में निरर्थक शब्दों का प्रयोग किया?
questions.explanation: Hermann Ebbinghaus used nonsense syllables (like DAX, BOK) in his studies of memory and forgetting. (Q12 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: When was first Psychological lab established in India?
questions.textHi: भारत में प्रथम मनोविज्ञान की प्रयोगशाला कब स्थापित हुई?
questions.explanation: India's first psychology laboratory was set up at Calcutta University in 1916. (Q13 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: When two opposing motivation arise at the same time and want their satisfaction at the same time, is called
questions.textHi: जब दो विरोधी प्रेरणाएँ एक समय में उत्पन्न हो जाएँ तथा एक समय में ही उसकी संतुष्टि चाहें, उसे कहेंगे
questions.explanation: A conflict arises when two opposing motives demand satisfaction at the same time. (Q14 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Who gave the theory of 'Psychosocial' development?
questions.textHi: 'मनोसामाजिक विकास' का सिद्धान्त किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: Erik Erikson proposed eight psychosocial stages of development. (Q15 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Who gave the concept of Concrete, Abstract and Social Intelligence?
questions.textHi: मूर्त, अमूर्त एवं सामाजिक बुद्धि का समप्रत्यय किसके द्वारा दिया गया?
questions.explanation: E.L. Thorndike classified intelligence into abstract, concrete (mechanical) and social intelligence. (Q16 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Which is not a Personality Test?
questions.textHi: कौन सा व्यक्तित्व परीक्षण नहीं है?
questions.explanation: The Binet-Simon scale is an intelligence test; Rorschach, 16 PF and TAT measure personality. (Q17 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Child Development is a product of interaction between Heredity and ……………
questions.textHi: बालक का विकास आनुवंशिकता व........ की अंतः क्रिया का परिणाम होता है।
questions.explanation: Development results from the interaction of heredity and environment. (Q18 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: 'The learner, the learning processes and the learning situations' are main aspects of
questions.textHi: 'शिक्षार्थी, अधिगम की प्रक्रियाएं व सीखने की परिस्थितियाँ' मुख्य पहलू हैं
questions.explanation: Educational psychology studies the learner, the learning process and the learning situation. (Q19 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Development is a ............ process.
questions.explanation: Development is continuous, from conception to death. (Q20 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Experiment is a method of testing.................
questions.textHi: प्रयोग.............. के परीक्षण की एक विधि है।
questions.explanation: An experiment is a controlled method of testing a hypothesis. (Q21 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: On which development is Jean Piaget's theory of child development based?
questions.textHi: जीन पियाजे का बाल विकास का सिद्धांत किस विकास पर आधारित है?
questions.explanation: Piaget's theory explains cognitive (intellectual) development. (Q22 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: To write down the behaviours that happen on the spot in that order is called
questions.textHi: मौके पर घट रहे व्यवहारों को उसी क्रम में लिखना .......... कहलाता है।
questions.explanation: A narrative (running) record writes down behaviour as it happens, in the order it occurs. (Q24 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Learning is a modification in a behaviour which is relatively ........
questions.textHi: अधिगम, व्यवहार में परिवर्तन को कहते हैं जो कि अपेक्षाकृत …..........परिवर्तन होते हैं।
questions.explanation: Learning is a relatively permanent change in behaviour resulting from experience. (Q25 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: The most important objective of Education is
questions.textHi: शिक्षा का अति महत्वपूर्ण उद्देश्य है
questions.explanation: The main aim of education is the all-round (harmonious) development of the child. (Q26 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Achievement, relationship, power are............... kind of motives.
questions.textHi: उपलब्धि, संबंध, शक्ति ...…………. प्रकार के अभिप्रेरक हैं।
questions.explanation: Achievement, affiliation and power are acquired psychological (social) motives, not biological drives. (Q27 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: “Bhatia Battery” is used in which test?
questions.textHi: “भाटिया बैटरी” का प्रयोग किस परीक्षण में किया जाता है?
questions.explanation: The Bhatia Battery is an Indian performance test of intelligence by C.M. Bhatia. (Q28 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Maslow's theory of Motivation is also known as:
questions.textHi: मैस्लो के अभिप्रेरणा सिद्धान्त को .....…….. का सिद्धान्त भी कहा जाता है।
questions.explanation: Maslow's theory is the hierarchy of needs. (Q29 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Attention is a ………..process.
questions.textHi: अवधान एक .………… प्रक्रिया है।
questions.explanation: Attention is selective: we focus on some stimuli and ignore others. (Q30 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Pick up the correctly spelt / Pick up the correctly spelt word. (i)
questions.explanation: 'Disciple' is the correct spelling. (Q31 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Pick up the correctly spelt / Pick up the correctly spelt word. (ii)
questions.explanation: 'Perform' is the correct spelling. (Q32 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Pick up the correctly spelt / Pick up the correctly spelt word. (iii)
questions.explanation: 'Discipline' is the correct spelling. (Q33 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct option of indirect form of speech. / She says to me, " I was unwell"
options: She said to me that she was unwell.
She tells me that she was unwell.
She tells to me that she was unwell.
She says to me that she was unwell
questions.explanation: With a present-tense reporting verb the reported tense is not changed: She tells me that she was unwell. (Q34 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct option of indirect form of speech. / He said to me, "I have a friend in Shimla".
options: He told me that he had a friend in Shimla.
He said to me that I have a friend in Shimla.
He told me that I have a friend in Shimla.
He said to me that he had a friend in Shimla.
questions.explanation: 'Said to' becomes 'told' and the present 'have' changes to past 'had'. (Q35 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym for the word in capital letters. / COPE
questions.explanation: 'Cope' means to manage or deal with something difficult. (Q36 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym for the word in capital letters. / INNATE
questions.explanation: 'Innate' means inborn, present from birth. (Q37 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Identify the appropriate alternative from the given options for filling in the blank. / We ........ serve our parents.
questions.explanation: 'Ought to' expresses moral duty, as in serving our parents. (Q38 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Identify the appropriate options for filling in the blank / Five Rupees............... an excessive price for this pe
questions.explanation: A sum of money treated as one amount takes a singular verb: Five rupees is ... (Q40 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Identify the appropriate option for filling in the blank. / Money makes the ........ go.
questions.explanation: The proverb is "Money makes the mare go". (Q42 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the word which is most opposite in meaning to the word printed in CAPITALS. / VIRTUE
questions.explanation: Vice is the opposite of virtue. (Q43 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the word which is most opposite in meaning to the word printed in CAPITALS. / HOPE
questions.explanation: Despair (loss of hope) is the opposite of hope. (Q44 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the most suitable modal for the blank. / ........ God bless you with wisdom!
questions.explanation: 'May' expresses a wish or blessing: May God bless you. (Q45 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the most suitable modal from the given choices for blank space / ...... you speak for two hours at a stretch?
questions.explanation: 'Can' asks about ability: Can you speak for two hours at a stretch? (Q46 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Identify the appropriate alternative from the given options for filling in the blanks. / Where there is a will, there.... a way.
questions.explanation: The proverb is "Where there is a will, there is a way". (Q48 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Identify the appropriate alternative from the given options for filling in the blanks. / God helps those who. ...themselves.
questions.explanation: The proverb is "God helps those who help themselves". (Q49 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct form of voice. / He reads a book.
options: A book is read by him.
A book was read by him.
A book was read by me.
A book is read by me.
questions.explanation: Simple present passive: is/am/are + past participle: A book is read by him. (Q50 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct form of voice. / I will invite him to tea.
options: He will invited to tea by me.
He will be invited to tea by me.
He will be invited to tea by him.
He will invited to tea by him.
questions.explanation: Future passive: will be + past participle: He will be invited to tea by me. (Q51 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Fill in the blanks with appropriate conjunction for the given questions. / Run fast.................. you should miss the train.
questions.explanation: 'Lest' means 'so that ... not': Run fast lest you should miss the train. (Q52 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Fill in the blanks with appropriate conjunction for the given questions. / You are................. a writer..……..a teacher.
questions.explanation: The correlative pair is 'both ... and'. (Q53 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the correct article from the given options / He is …….. wisest boy in ….. class.
questions.explanation: Superlatives take 'the', and 'the class' refers to a specific class. (Q54 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the correct article from the given options / It took me …… hour to reach home.
questions.explanation: 'Hour' begins with a vowel sound (silent h), so it takes 'an'. (Q55 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the most appropriate preposition out of the given choices / He jumped ………. the well.
questions.explanation: 'Into' shows movement from outside to inside. (Q58 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the most appropriate preposition. / I am busy ........ dawn to dusk.
questions.explanation: The phrase is 'from dawn to dusk'. (Q59 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the most appropriate preposition out of the given choices / I have lived here ……..many days.
questions.explanation: 'For' is used with a period of time: for many days. (Q60 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: "गिरिधर" समस्त पद में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: गिरिधर = गिरि (पर्वत) को धारण करने वाला अर्थात् श्रीकृष्ण; अन्य अर्थ प्रधान होने से बहुव्रीहि समास। (Q62 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: किसी भी भाषा की मौखिक ध्वनियों को प्रकट करने वाले लेखन-चिह्नों को क्या कहते हैं?
questions.explanation: ध्वनियों को लिखित रूप में प्रकट करने वाले चिह्नों की व्यवस्था लिपि कहलाती है। (Q63 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: अट्टालिका शब्द है-
questions.explanation: अट्टालिका संस्कृत का मूल (तत्सम) शब्द है। (Q65 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: समूहवाची शब्द 'कुंज' किसके साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation: लताओं के समूह को 'लताकुंज' कहते हैं। (Q66 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'कवि' का स्त्रीलिंग है-
questions.explanation: 'कवि' का स्त्रीलिंग 'कवयित्री' है। (Q67 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: कर्म के आधार पर क्रिया के कितने भेद हैं?
questions.explanation: कर्म के आधार पर क्रिया के दो भेद हैं: सकर्मक और अकर्मक। (Q68 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'शिव' का विशेषण क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'शिव' से बना विशेषण 'शैव' (शिव का उपासक/शिव से संबंधित) है। (Q69 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'गंगा गए गंगादास, जमुना गए जमुनादास' का अर्थ है
options: जिसका कोई दृढ़ सिद्धान्त नहीं होता
questions.explanation: यह लोकोक्ति ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए है जिसका कोई दृढ़ सिद्धान्त नहीं होता और जो अवसर देखकर बदल जाता है। (Q71 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: लिंग की दृष्टि से 'दही' क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'दही' पुल्लिंग शब्द है (दही खट्टा है)। (Q72 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: इनमें से कौन भक्तिकाल का कवि नहीं है?
questions.explanation: अमीर खुसरो आदिकाल के कवि हैं; नंददास, रसखान और नाभादास भक्तिकाल के कवि हैं। (Q73 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: "लालटेन " शब्द है
questions.explanation: 'लालटेन' अंग्रेज़ी 'Lantern' से आया विदेशज शब्द है। (Q74 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'रात-दिन' शब्द में समास बताने के लिए उचित विकल्प का चयन करें
questions.explanation: रात-दिन = रात और दिन; दोनों पद प्रधान होने से द्वन्द्व समास। (Q75 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'आलस्य' शब्द का विशेषण क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'आलस्य' (संज्ञा) का विशेषण 'आलसी' है। (Q76 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: चुनाव क्षेत्रों का समय-समय पर ...किया जाता है।
questions.explanation: चुनाव क्षेत्रों की सीमाओं का पुनर्निर्धारण परिसीमन कहलाता है। (Q77 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'के लिए' किस कारक का चिह्न है?
questions.explanation: 'के लिए' सम्प्रदान कारक का चिह्न है। (Q78 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'क्ष' ध्वनि किसके अन्तर्गत आती है?
questions.explanation: 'क्ष' (क् + ष) संयुक्त वर्ण (संयुक्त व्यंजन) है। (Q79 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: इनमें कौन-सा स्वर सन्धि का उदाहरण है?
questions.explanation: पवन = पो + अन (अयादि संधि), जो स्वर संधि का भेद है; मनोहर और नमस्कार विसर्ग संधि, संयोग व्यंजन संधि हैं। (Q81 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-9.html

questions.text: उचित विकल्प चुनिए- "अंगूठा दिखाना"
questions.explanation: 'अंगूठा दिखाना' का अर्थ है समय पर देने से इनकार कर देना। (Q82 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-9.html

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'रसराज' कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: श्रृंगार रस को रसराज कहा जाता है। (Q83 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-9.html

questions.text: हिन्दी की विशिष्ट बोली 'ब्रजभाषा' किस रूप में सबसे अधिक प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: ब्रजभाषा मध्यकाल में काव्यभाषा के रूप में सबसे अधिक प्रसिद्ध रही (सूरदास, बिहारी आदि)। (Q84 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-9.html

questions.text: श्रृंगार रस का स्थायी भाव है
questions.explanation: श्रृंगार रस का स्थायी भाव रति है। (Q85 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-9.html

questions.text: हिंदी में स्वतंत्र रूप से बोले जाने वाले वर्ण क्या कहलाते हैं?
questions.explanation: स्वर बिना किसी अन्य वर्ण की सहायता के स्वतंत्र रूप से बोले जाते हैं। (Q86 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-9.html

questions.text: भूतकाल के कितने भेद हैं?
questions.explanation: भूतकाल के छह भेद हैं: सामान्य, आसन्न, पूर्ण, अपूर्ण, संदिग्ध और हेतुहेतुमद् भूत। (Q87 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-9.html

questions.text: ह्रस्व, दीर्घ, प्लुत किसके भेद हैं?
questions.explanation: मात्रा (उच्चारण-काल) के आधार पर स्वर के तीन भेद हैं: ह्रस्व, दीर्घ और प्लुत। (Q88 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-9.html

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में कौन-सा 'यौगिक' शब्द है?
questions.explanation: विद्यालय = विद्या + आलय; सार्थक खंडों से बना होने से यौगिक शब्द है। (Q89 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-9.html

questions.text: देवनागरी हिन्दी व संस्कृत के अतिरिक्त अन्य किस भाषा की लिपि है?
questions.explanation: देवनागरी लिपि में हिन्दी, संस्कृत के अतिरिक्त मराठी और नेपाली भी लिखी जाती हैं। (Q90 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-9.html

questions.text: The least four-digit number which is a perfect square is
questions.textHi: चार अंकों की सबसे छोटी संख्या जो पूर्ण वर्ग हो, है
questions.explanation: 32² = 1024 is the smallest four-digit perfect square (31² = 961). (Q91 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: Sum of the place values of 6 in the number 63606 is
questions.textHi: संख्या 63606 में 6 के स्थानीय मानों का योग है
questions.explanation: In 63606 the 6s have place values 60000, 600 and 6; sum = 60606. (Q92 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: The number of integers less than -3 but greater than -8 is
questions.textHi: -3 से छोटी पर -8 से बड़ी पूर्णांकों की संख्या है
questions.explanation: The integers are −7, −6, −5 and −4, i.e. 4 integers. (Q93 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: One of the factors of x² − z² + y² − 2xy is
questions.textHi: x² − z² + y² − 2xy का एक गुणनखण्ड है
questions.explanation: x² − 2xy + y² − z² = (x − y)² − z² = (x − y + z)(x − y − z). (Q94 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: HCF of two numbers is 28 and their LCM is 336. If one number is 112, then the other number is
questions.textHi: दो संख्याओं का महत्तम समापवर्तक 28 तथा उनका लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य 336 है। यदि एक संख्या 112 हो, तो दूसरी संख्या है
questions.explanation: Other number = HCF × LCM ÷ given number = 28 × 336 ÷ 112 = 84. (Q95 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: The square root of 0.0016 is
questions.textHi: 0.0016 का वर्गमूल है
questions.explanation: 0.04 × 0.04 = 0.0016. (Q96 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: Out of 25 students, 72% are good in mathematics. How many are not good in mathematics?
questions.textHi: 25 विद्यार्थियों में से 72% गणित में रुचि रखते हैं। कितने विद्यार्थी गणित में रुचि नहीं रखते हैं?
questions.explanation: 72% of 25 = 18 are good, so 25 − 18 = 7 are not. (Q97 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: Find the fraction equivalent to 15/35 with denominator 7.
questions.textHi: 15/35 के बराबर भिन्न ज्ञात करें जिसका हर 7 हो?
questions.explanation: 15/35 = 3/7 (dividing numerator and denominator by 5). (Q98 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: The value of (1 − tan²45°)/(1 + tan²45°) is
questions.textHi: (1 − tan²45°)/(1 + tan²45°) का मान है
questions.explanation: tan 45° = 1, so (1 − 1)/(1 + 1) = 0. (Q99 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: The circumference of the base of a right circular cylinder is 440 cm and its height is 2 m. Find the volume of the cylinder? (π = 22/7)
questions.textHi: किसी लंब वृत्तीय बेलन के आधार की परिधि 440 cm है और इसकी ऊँचाई 2 m है। बेलन का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिये? (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: 2πr = 440 cm gives r = 70 cm = 0.7 m; V = πr²h = 22/7 × 0.49 × 2 = 3.08 m³. (Q100 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: In 1998 the population of a country was 30.3 million. Which number is the same as 30.3 million?
questions.textHi: 1998 में किसी देश की जनसंख्या 30.3 मिलियन थी। कौन-सी संख्या 30.3 मिलियन के समान है?
questions.explanation: 30.3 million = 30.3 × 1,000,000 = 30,300,000. (Q101 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-11.html

questions.text: Find the area of a rhombus whose diagonals are 10 cm and 8.2 cm long.
questions.textHi: उस समचतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके विकर्णों की लम्बाइयाँ 10 cm और 8.2 cm हैं।
questions.explanation: Area of a rhombus = ½ × d₁ × d₂ = ½ × 10 × 8.2 = 41 cm². (Q104 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-11.html

questions.text: The three angles of a quadrilateral are 75°, 90° and 75°. Its fourth angle will be-
questions.textHi: एक चतुर्भुज के तीन कोण 75°, 90° और 75° हैं। इसका चौथा कोण होगा-
questions.explanation: Angles of a quadrilateral add to 360°: 360 − (75 + 90 + 75) = 120°. (Q105 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-11.html

questions.text: At what rate will ₹ 280 simple interest be payable on ₹ 56000 after 2 years?
questions.textHi: ₹ 56000 पर किस दर से 2 वर्ष बाद ₹ 280 साधारण ब्याज देय होगा?
questions.explanation: R = SI × 100 / (P × T) = 280 × 100 / (56000 × 2) = 0.25%. (Q106 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-11.html
4 occurs three times, more than any other value. (Q107 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-11.html

questions.text: The 10th term of the arithmetic progression 2, 7, 12.............. will be-
questions.explanation: a = 2, d = 5: a₁₀ = 2 + 9 × 5 = 47. (Q108 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-11.html

questions.text: Which of the following formula gives the perimeter of a semicircle whose radius is 'r'?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में कौन सा सूत्र अर्धवृत का परिमाप दर्शाता है, जिसकी त्रिज्या 'r' है?
questions.explanation: Perimeter of a semicircle = half the circumference + diameter = πr + 2r. (Q109 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-11.html

questions.text: The mean of the first five whole numbers is
questions.textHi: प्रथम पाँच पूर्ण संख्याओं का माध्य है-
questions.explanation: The first five whole numbers are 0, 1, 2, 3, 4; mean = 10/5 = 2. (Q112 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-12.html

questions.text: The x-axis value of a point (its x-coordinate) is also known as
questions.textHi: किसी बिंदु के x-निर्देशांक को ........ भी कहा जाता है
questions.explanation: The x-coordinate of a point is called the abscissa (भुज); the y-coordinate is the ordinate. (Q114 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-12.html

questions.text: If tan A = cot B then A+B=......
questions.textHi: यदि tan A = cot B, तो A + B = ......
questions.explanation: tan A = cot(90° − A), so cot B = cot(90° − A) gives A + B = 90°. (Q116 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-12.html

questions.text: The cost price of a flower vase is Rs 120. If the shopkeeper sells it at a 10% loss, its selling price will be
questions.textHi: एक फूलदान का क्रय मूल्य Rs 120 है। यदि दुकानदार इसे 10% हानि पर बेचता है तो इसका विक्रय मूल्य क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: SP = 120 × 90/100 = Rs 108. (Q117 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-12.html

questions.text: If √(1 + x/144) = 13/12, then the value of x is
questions.explanation: 1 + x/144 = 169/144, so x/144 = 25/144 and x = 25. (Q118 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-12.html

questions.text: The number zero (0) is-
questions.textHi: संख्या शुन्य (0) है-
questions.explanation: Zero is a whole number; it is not a natural number, not prime and is even. (Q119 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-12.html

questions.text: When was the Arya Samaj established?
questions.textHi: आर्य समाज की स्थापना कब हुई?
questions.explanation: Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in Bombay in 1875. (Q121 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-13.html

questions.text: Which Himachali was awarded independent India's first Param Vir Chakra (posthumously)?
questions.textHi: स्वतंत्र भारत का पहला परमवीर चक्र (मरणोपरांत) किस हिमाचली को प्रदान किया गया?
questions.explanation: Major Som Nath Sharma of Kangra received the first Param Vir Chakra for the Battle of Badgam (1947). (Q122 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-13.html

questions.text: On which of the following days the birthday of Major Dhyan Chand is celebrated as National Sports Day?
questions.textHi: मेजर ध्यान चन्द के जन्म दिवस को राष्ट्रीय खेल दिवस के रूप में निम्नलिखित में से किस दिन मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: National Sports Day (29 August) marks Major Dhyan Chand's birthday. (Q123 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-13.html

questions.text: What is the total number of Suktas (hymns) in the Rigveda?
questions.textHi: ऋग्वेद में सूक्तों की कुल संख्या कितनी है?
questions.explanation: The Rigveda has 1028 suktas (1017 plus 11 Valakhilya hymns) in 10 mandalas. (Q124 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-13.html

questions.text: Deficiency of which vitamin causes Rickets?
questions.textHi: किस विटामिन की कमी से रिकेट्स रोग होता है?
questions.explanation: Vitamin D deficiency causes rickets (soft, weak bones) in children. (Q125 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-13.html

questions.text: Which of the following is not appointed by the President of India?
questions.textHi: इनमें से किस की नियुक्ति भारत के राष्ट्रपति द्वारा नहीं की जाती है?
questions.explanation: The Vice President is elected by an electoral college of both Houses of Parliament, not appointed by the President. (Q126 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-13.html

questions.text: Who was the founder king of Chamba State?
questions.textHi: चम्बा राज्य का संस्थापक राजा कौन था?
questions.explanation: Raja Meru Varman founded the state with its capital at Brahmapura (Bharmour) in the 6th century; Sahil Varman later founded Chamba town. (Q127 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-13.html

questions.text: Jhanjhar dance of Himachal Pradesh is related to which district?
questions.textHi: हिमाचल प्रदेश का झांझर नृत्य किस जिले से सम्बन्धित है?
questions.explanation: Jhanjhar is a folk dance of Chamba district. (Q128 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-13.html

questions.text: What is the name of Sugar found in milk?
questions.textHi: दूध में पाई जाने वाली चीनी क्या है?
questions.explanation: Lactose is the sugar found in milk. (Q129 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-13.html

questions.text: What is the total number of bones in the adult human body?
questions.textHi: वयस्क मानव शरीर में अस्थियों की कुल संख्या कितनी है?
questions.explanation: An adult human skeleton has 206 bones. (Q130 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-13.html

questions.text: When is World Science Day celebrated?
questions.textHi: विश्व विज्ञान दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: World Science Day for Peace and Development is observed on 10 November (28 February is National Science Day in India). (Q131 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: Which instrument measures Humidity?
questions.textHi: आर्द्रता (नमी) किस उपकरण से मापी जाती है?
questions.explanation: A hygrometer measures humidity; a hydrometer measures the density of liquids. (Q132 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: World Population Day is celebrated on
questions.textHi: विश्व जनसंख्या दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: World Population Day is observed on 11 July. (Q133 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: Fundamental Duties of Indian citizens are mentioned in
questions.textHi: भारतीय नागरिकों के मौलिक कर्त्तव्यों का उल्लेख है
questions.explanation: Fundamental Duties are in Part IV-A (Article 51A), added by the 42nd Amendment, 1976. (Q134 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: Who is the Author of Vande Mataram?
questions.textHi: वन्दे मातरम् का लेखक कौन है?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote "Vande Mataram" in his novel Anandamath. (Q136 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC) is in which State?
questions.textHi: राष्ट्रीय इंडियन मिलिट्रि कॉलेज (RIMC) किस राज्य में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: RIMC is at Dehradun, Uttarakhand. (Q137 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: Who started Non-cooperation movement?
questions.textHi: असहयोग आंदोलन किसने शुरू किया?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi launched the Non-cooperation Movement in 1920. (Q138 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: Which is the most densely populated district of Himachal Pradesh (Census 2011)?
questions.textHi: हिमाचल प्रदेश का सबसे अधिक जनसंख्या घनत्व वाला जिला कौन-सा है (जनगणना 2011)?
questions.explanation: Hamirpur has the highest population density in Himachal (about 407 per sq km, Census 2011). (Q139 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: Chamera Hydroelectric Project is situated on which River?
questions.textHi: चमेरा जल विद्युत परियोजना किस नदी पर स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The Chamera hydroelectric projects are on the Ravi river in Chamba district. (Q140 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: Kehluri dialect is spoken in which part of Himachal Pradesh?
questions.textHi: कहलूरी बोली हिमाचल प्रदेश के किस भाग में बोली जाती है?
questions.explanation: Kehluri is spoken in Bilaspur, the former Kahlur state. (Q141 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: LPG is abbreviation of :
questions.textHi: एलपीजी संक्षिप्त रूप है :
questions.explanation: LPG stands for Liquefied Petroleum Gas. (Q143 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: The author of "India Divided" is
questions.textHi: "इंडिया डिवाइडेड" के लेखक हैं
questions.explanation: "India Divided" (1946) was written by Dr. Rajendra Prasad. (Q145 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: “Kufri Jeevan” and “Kufri Jyoti” are two famous varieties of :
questions.textHi: "कुफरी जीवन" और "कुफरी ज्योति" दो प्रसिद्ध किस्में हैं:
questions.explanation: Kufri Jeevan and Kufri Jyoti are potato varieties from the Central Potato Research Institute, Shimla. (Q146 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Who invited Babur to invade India?
questions.textHi: बाबर को भारत पर आक्रमण करने के लिए किसने आमंत्रित किया?
questions.explanation: Daulat Khan Lodi, governor of Punjab, invited Babur to invade India. (Q147 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Indrahar Pass is situated on the border of which two districts?
questions.textHi: इन्द्रहर दर्रा किन दो जिलों की सीमा पर स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Indrahar Pass in the Dhauladhar range lies on the Kangra-Chamba border. (Q148 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: On which date did the revolt of 1857 start from Meerut?
questions.textHi: 1857 का विद्रोह मेरठ से किस तारीख को शुरू हुआ था?
questions.explanation: The revolt began at Meerut on 10 May 1857. (Q149 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: The term "double fault" is associated with
questions.textHi: शब्द "डबल फॉल्ट" संबंधित है:
questions.explanation: A double fault (two faulty serves) is a term in tennis. (Q150 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-jbt-june-2022-paper-part-15.html
